description: Ask for one AI call to the job's customer: appointment_reminder (needs a future visit_id), on_my_way (a visit today with an assigned worker) or job_status (an open job). No sales or payment calls. The call is refused with the reason unless the customer gave AI call consent themselves in the last 12 months, is not on the stop list, and is not in Washington; it waits for 9 AM to 8 PM where the customer is; at most 1 attempt per job per day (plus one more on_my_way call that day when the first was not answered) and 2 per customer per week. Owner or office.
name: phone_callCustomer
